about: Who is told what (notifications/notices.ts), word for word from the SQL triggers in supabase/migrations/20261030000400_notifications.sql, 20261030000500_refunds.sql (refund outcomes) and 20261030000600_notification_images.sql (the order's priciest line with a photo). Every case is a pure call with the docs before and after one write; "expect.notices" lists them in order ("recipient": a uid or "staff" = every staff member but "except"; "key" = the event index, p<n> for a payment/tracking change, r<refundId>, s<event> for stock). The trigger writes each as users/{uid}/notifications/<sourceId>_<key>_<kind>_<uid> with create(), so a retry never duplicates. Times are IST.

notExpressed.why: Clients can't insert notifications and can only set readAt: Security Rules (functions/test/rules/service.test.ts).
push_notification via Vault/pg_net: the pushNotification trigger sends through the Admin SDK; FCM isn't emulated, so its data keys are checked by contract.ts pushData.
Feedback and stock photos come from reading the order or product in the trigger (notifications/triggers.ts); the pure cases take the path as input.
The 90-day cleanup and 270-day token expiry are TTL policies on expireAt (model/notifications.ts, model/users.ts).
